newsitem.title: CHINA: China to spend $430 mln on polyester technology.
newsitem.headline: China to spend $430 mln on polyester technology.

text.p: China is planning to import equipment and technology worth $430 million to boost production of polyester, the official China Daily said on Friday.

Two subsidiaries of the China Petrochemical Corp had signed contracts with several foreign firms for the equipment, which would be financed by the Export and Import Bank of Japan and by credits from Japan, Germany and the United States, it said.

The agency gave no details of the foreign companies involved, but said the technology would be used by China's Luoyang General Petrochemical Works in central Henan province and Tianjin Petrochemical Co in the northern port city of Tianjin.
The imports would be used in two projects by the firms that would each have annual production capacity of 200,000 tonnes of polyester, it said, but gave no details.
China was currently capable of producing 1.9 million tonnes of polyester a year, and capacity was expected to rise to an annual 2.6 million tonnes by the end of the century, it said.
